description: A personal AI prompts management tool to store, organize, and quickly retrieve LLM prompts
##: Windows build is shipped as a portable ZIP (win_x64 only); no installer.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: the GitHub release asset carries a sha256 digest that Excavator reads automatically.
Prompt vaults live in user-chosen folders (one prome.db SQLite file per vault), so nothing under the app dir needs persisting.
